title: distichorchis quadrisulcata
intro: Distichorchis quadrisulcata, commonly known as the Four-Grooved Orchid, is a plant species in the orchid family native to Australia. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Distichorchis quadrisulcata include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms associated with these conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
